_comment: Copy to bench/config.json. 'factory' is a conformance Driver factory (module:function) returning an object with adapter/configure/receipts/close, see tests/adapter_conformance/README.md. Project policy: FREE models only ($0 paid spend), run with `--live --free-only`. Models must be exact ':free' OpenRouter routes that are zero-priced and fresh in the snapshot named by RCD_ZEROCLAW_FREE_MODELS (see integrations/zeroclaw/free-models.example.json). ZeroClaw also needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment. The picoclaw factory module does not exist yet, so that runtime records 'unavailable' until a live driver is written.
